_comment: Pinned upstream revisions for the iSH emulator core. ish/scripts/fetch-sources.sh reads this file and refuses to build a tree that does not match it; ish/scripts/verify-tree.sh re-checks the result. Bumping a revision is a deliberate act: change the commit here, re-run fetch-sources.sh, review the patches that no longer apply, then rebuild and re-run the acceptance commands.

notes: This is the OpenMinis ARM64 fork of ish-app/ish, not upstream ish-app/ish.
The dsh-ios baseline this replaces was 7e100366a4b59557a4a0c4657d0d6115e99d1f5e (2026-08-13).

linux.notes: Only used by the Linux-kernel build (-Dkernel=linux). The ish kernel build ignores it.
